scope: Five synthetic seats using production Git transport, station, advisory, mailroom, and model-adapter code; local bare Git and a deterministic loopback HTTP provider.
limitations: No live Claude, DeepSeek, Gemini, Muse, or Codex inference was tested.
No remote Station Node or Route66 installation was verified.
Per-seat sorting is routing for cooperating agents, not secrecy from shared repository readers.
Crash injection uses the adapter durable-result fault hook; no operating-system process was killed.

checks.name: five independent private seats initialize over real local Git
Dot queues four addressed assignments and one explicit broadcast
mailrooms isolate directed work, deliver broadcast once, and quarantine malformed advisory
actual HTTP provider calls carry only each assigned task and selected source
restart recovers durable Claude result without repeating provider inference
lost adapter receipt reuses the stable pending result without duplicate outbox work
concurrent Git writers preserve three successful replies while Gemini remains pending
timed out provider task retries with bounded attempts and returns its fourth result
Dot receives four correlated draft results with truthful unverified status
lost transport sent receipt replays the same identity without a new Git commit
cursor replay and completed adapter restarts create no extra provider calls or messages
one unavailable Git seat backs off while four other seats keep polling
public source fingerprint stayed unchanged throughout the simulation
